features.name: Clean Architecture-inspired Layers
features.subtitle: Architecture & Structure
features.implementationDetails: The app uses logical Domain, Data, and feature-presentation layers inside one application target. Use cases depend on repository protocols and map failures before presentation. Folder boundaries are conventions rather than compile-time module boundaries; repository protocols currently live under Data.

bestPractices.title: Honest boundaries
bestPractices.description: The folders communicate dependency direction, while the single app target means the compiler does not enforce it.

bestPractices.title: Domain models
bestPractices.description: Networking DTOs are mapped before the presentation layer consumes feature data.

features.name: MVVM Pattern
features.subtitle: Presentation Architecture
features.implementationDetails: SwiftUI views render explicit state and forward user events. @MainActor, @Observable view models orchestrate use cases, decorator mappers, and feature routers without owning concrete data implementations.

bestPractices.title: State-driven views
bestPractices.description: Views switch over a finite state enum instead of coordinating data access themselves.

bestPractices.title: Injected collaborators
bestPractices.description: View models receive their use case, router, and presentation mapper through initializers.

features.name: Typed Router Pattern
features.subtitle: Navigation & Routing
features.implementationDetails: Each feature defines Codable, Hashable route values and a small router protocol. Concrete feature routers push those values into the app-level NavigationPath; route resolvers build destinations.

bestPractices.title: Typed routes
bestPractices.description: Navigation values are feature-specific enums rather than unstructured strings.

bestPractices.title: View-model boundary
bestPractices.description: View models depend on feature router protocols instead of NavigationPath.

features.name: Hierarchical Dependency Injection
features.subtitle: Composition & Lifetimes
features.implementationDetails: ArquitecturaApp is the application composition root: it creates the app-lifetime AppDependencies and AppRouterImpl. Feature factories are screen-scoped sub-composition-roots that assemble data sources, repositories, use cases, mappers, routers, view models, and views.

bestPractices.title: App lifetime
bestPractices.description: The API client and app router are created once at the application boundary.

bestPractices.title: Screen lifetime
bestPractices.description: Feature factories create the concrete screen graph while exposing only a configured view.

features.name: Layered + Feature Organization
features.subtitle: Project Structure
features.implementationDetails: The repository uses a hybrid organization. Domain and Data are top-level layers subdivided by feature. Features groups presentation concerns vertically into DI, Navigation, Presentation, and UI. It is not a full vertical-slice layout.

bestPractices.title: Matching feature names
bestPractices.description: Architecture, ArchitectureDetail, PokemonList, and PokemonDetail use matching names across their layers.

bestPractices.title: Presentation grouping
bestPractices.description: UI state, decorator mapping, navigation, and DI stay together under each presentation feature.

features.name: SwiftUI
features.subtitle: User Interface
features.implementationDetails: Screens are composed with SwiftUI and render idle, loading, loaded, and error states. Reusable components and design tokens keep the view layer focused on rendering and interaction.

bestPractices.title: Explicit rendering
bestPractices.description: Every screen state has a visible SwiftUI branch.

bestPractices.title: Component extraction
bestPractices.description: Rows, headers, cards, and detail sections live in focused component files.

features.name: @Observable
features.subtitle: Observation
features.implementationDetails: Mutable UI coordinators use the Observation framework. View models and the concrete app router are @Observable and main-actor isolated; SwiftUI stores injected view models with @State and binds the router with @Bindable.

bestPractices.title: Read-only state
bestPractices.description: Presentation state uses private(set) so views observe it without mutating it directly.

bestPractices.title: Actor isolation
bestPractices.description: Observable UI state is explicitly isolated to MainActor.

features.name: Design System Tokens
features.subtitle: Visual System
features.implementationDetails: Core/DesignSystem centralizes adaptive colors, semantic typography, icon sizes, and spacing. AppColors resolves light and dark values at render time.

codeExample.code:
enum Spacing {
    static let xs: CGFloat = 4
    static let sm: CGFloat = 8
    static let md: CGFloat = 16
    static let lg: CGFloat = 24
    static let xl: CGFloat = 32
    static let xxl: CGFloat = 48

    static let zero: CGFloat = 0
}

bestPractices.title: Semantic colors
bestPractices.description: Views consume names such as text, surface, success, and divider instead of literals.

bestPractices.title: System typography
bestPractices.description: Typography tokens wrap semantic SwiftUI fonts that participate in Dynamic Type.

features.name: Reusable ViewModifiers
features.subtitle: Reusable Presentation
features.implementationDetails: Shared SwiftUI modifiers encapsulate list styling, card materials, button presentation, and entrance animations. The glass card respects Reduce Transparency and the staggered animation respects Reduce Motion.

bestPractices.title: Accessibility settings
bestPractices.description: Visual effects provide fallbacks for reduced transparency and reduced motion.

bestPractices.title: Shared styling
bestPractices.description: Repeated presentation rules are exposed through focused View extensions.

features.name: Explicit View State
features.subtitle: State Modeling
features.implementationDetails: Feature state is modeled in dedicated enums rather than hidden in combinations of booleans. Each enum carries the decorator required by its loaded or error branch.

bestPractices.title: Finite states
bestPractices.description: The enum prevents incompatible loading, success, and failure states from coexisting.

bestPractices.title: Presentation values
bestPractices.description: Loaded state carries decorators already prepared for the view.

features.name: Centralized APIClient
features.subtitle: HTTP Client
features.implementationDetails: APIClientImpl builds URLRequests, executes them through DefaultInterceptorChain, validates 2xx responses, creates a fresh decoder per request, and maps transport or decoding failures to APIError. It supports environment-based Endpoint values and self-contained APIEndpoint values.

bestPractices.title: Injected client
bestPractices.description: Remote data sources receive the APIClient protocol from their feature factory.

bestPractices.title: Fresh decoder
bestPractices.description: The implementation creates a JSONDecoder per request instead of sharing mutable decoder state.

features.name: Endpoint Builders
features.subtitle: Request Modeling
features.implementationDetails: Endpoint models requests that use the injected environment base URL. APIEndpoint models external services that carry their own base URL. PokeAPIEndpoint provides typed factory methods for list, detail, and species paths.

bestPractices.title: Deterministic query order
bestPractices.description: Request builders sort query parameters before creating URLQueryItem values.

bestPractices.title: Explicit base URL ownership
bestPractices.description: Internal and external endpoint types make the source of their base URL explicit.

features.name: Typed API Errors
features.subtitle: Networking Failures
features.implementationDetails: APIError preserves transport, HTTP status and body data, decoding, invalid URL, and wrapped unknown failures. Its retryability policy treats transient URL errors, HTTP 5xx, and 429 as retry candidates.

codeExample.code:
nonisolated enum APIError: Error {
    case networkError(URLError)
    case httpError(statusCode: Int, data: Data?)
    case decodingError(DecodingError)
    case invalidURL
    case unknown(SendableError)
}

bestPractices.title: Preserved response context
bestPractices.description: HTTP errors retain status code and response data for later interpretation.

bestPractices.title: Cancellation
bestPractices.description: Cancelled URL requests become CancellationError instead of a user-facing network failure.

features.name: Error Layer Mapping
features.subtitle: Error Boundaries
features.implementationDetails: Repositories surface their data-layer failures. Use cases convert them with DomainError.map, and view models convert DomainError into localized ErrorDecorator values. This is the implemented mapping location; repositories do not perform the domain mapping.

bestPractices.title: Use-case boundary
bestPractices.description: Use cases are the point where data errors become feature-facing domain errors.

bestPractices.title: Localized presentation
bestPractices.description: ErrorDecorator owns user-facing localized text and retry affordance.

features.name: PokeAPI Example
features.subtitle: Runnable Integration
features.implementationDetails: The Try It flow is a working PokeAPI integration. It loads a paginated list, fetches item details in a throwing task group, maps DTOs to domain and presentation models, and navigates to a detail screen. The catalog uses the neutral SF Symbol globe; it bundles no Pokeball artwork.

bestPractices.title: Shared app client
bestPractices.description: Pokemon feature factories receive the app-lifetime APIClient through AppDependencies.

bestPractices.title: Partial detail failure
bestPractices.description: A failed item-detail request is logged and omitted without discarding successful list items.

features.name: SSL Public Key Pinning
features.subtitle: Transport Security
features.implementationDetails: SSLPinningDelegate validates server trust and compares the leaf certificate public-key SHA-256 hash with configured hashes. URLSessionFactory installs the delegate only when pinning is enabled and at least one hash exists. Development disables pinning; staging and production values are templates until replaced with real service configuration.

bestPractices.title: Configuration consistency
bestPractices.description: Debug builds assert when pinning is enabled without any configured hashes.

bestPractices.title: Template boundary
bestPractices.description: Placeholder staging and production values are identified as templates, not deployment proof.

features.name: Environment Configuration
features.subtitle: Build Configuration
features.implementationDetails: Base and per-environment xcconfig files populate Info.plist values. EnvironmentConfigurationImpl validates the base URL and reads API version, timeout, pinning flag, and public-key hashes. Development is the runnable reference; staging and production remain illustrative templates.

bestPractices.title: Info.plist bridge
bestPractices.description: Build settings flow into Info.plist and are parsed by one configuration implementation.

bestPractices.title: Validated required value
bestPractices.description: Missing or invalid base URLs fail dependency initialization instead of being silently guessed.

features.name: Swift Testing
features.subtitle: Automated Tests
features.implementationDetails: The unit-test target uses Swift Testing suites, tests, expectations, requirements, and parameterized cases. Tests cover navigation, networking, mappers, repositories, use cases, view models, and the bundled architecture data. There is no UI-test source suite in the current reference.

bestPractices.title: Swift Testing API
bestPractices.description: Tests use @Suite, @Test, #expect, and #require instead of XCTest assertions.

bestPractices.title: Shared test plan
bestPractices.description: ArquitecturaTests.xctestplan defines the unit-test target used by the shared scheme.

features.name: Protocol-based Testability
features.subtitle: Test Doubles
features.implementationDetails: Factories inject protocol-typed collaborators into repositories, use cases, view models, routers, and mappers. Tests replace those collaborators with focused mocks; actor-based mocks safely track mutable async interactions.

bestPractices.title: Protocol seams
bestPractices.description: Tests replace collaborators at existing initializer boundaries instead of using global state.

bestPractices.title: Actor mocks
bestPractices.description: Async repository mocks isolate their configured results and invocation counters.
